REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing) -> u3
(u0, switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, siren_ringing & !switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u2
(u1, else) -> u1
(u2, at_exit) -> u3
(u2, else) -> u2
(u3, else) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, at_exit & !siren_ringing, u3) -> 1.0
(u0, switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1
(u1, switch_toggled, u2) -> 0.1
(u2, at_exit, u3) -> 1.0
feedback: Format: all required headers (REWARD_MACHINE, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION, REWARD_FUNCTION) are present in the paper layout; FINAL_STATES is nonempty, u3 is declared in STATES, and u3 is the accepting state entered only on task success, so the final-states requirement is met. Semantic fidelity: the machine accepts exactly the traces the task pays for — the exit is reached either with no ring ever observed (u0 -> u3 on at_exit & !siren_ringing) or after at least one switch_toggled (u2 -> u3 on at_exit). Leaving siren_ringing unchecked on the u2 -> u3 edge is correct for this task, which asks for a flip 'once or more, before or after', not for a silent siren at the exit; a ring answered by a single flip, even with a later second ring still sounding, is a success here, and this task is deliberately weaker than the listed 'whenever the siren rings, turn it off' variant. A ring with no toggle ever traps the machine in u1, which has no exit edge and no reward, so exiting or timing out with an unanswered ring scores 0 as required. Persistent/event distinctions are respected: switch_toggled is used only as a one-step edge trigger, siren_ringing only as a persistent condition (the u0 guard fires on the onset step and u1 persists via else until a toggle), and at_exit only as the terminal trigger; note no ring can coincide with the exit step by environment rule. Ordered coverage: within each state the guards are pairwise disjoint given the environment constraints (at_exit never co-occurs with switch_toggled; the two u0 guards partition on siren_ringing) and every state carries an else self-loop, so irrelevant propositions (holding_box, box_fell) and all unlisted combinations are absorbed without spurious moves. Reachability and compactness: all four states are reachable (u1 via a ring, u2 via a toggle, u3 via the exit) and each is necessary, so 4 states is minimal for this semantics. Reward safety: total reward is bounded at 1.1; the single 0.1 shaping is paid exactly once for the flip subgoal (repeat toggles are unrewarded, so it cannot be farmed), the exogenous ring is correctly unpaid, and failed endings yield at most the 0.1 already earned. No regression edges are needed since both tracked obligations (ring happened, toggle happened) are monotone. Minor observations, not defects: the u0 -> u2 preemptive-toggle path is near-unreachable in practice (the siren starts by step 4 while reaching the switch takes on the order of 11 steps) but is the right treatment of the task's 'before' clause; a ring coinciding step-wise with the first toggle would be absorbed into u2 without re-registration, consistent with the one-flip reading and practically unreachable.
